bodyHtml:
PART V.  INVESTMENTS

 

     §412:10-500  Applicability of part.  This part sets forth the requirements and restrictions for investments made by all credit unions.  A credit union may invest its assets as may be permitted by this part and as may be provided elsewhere in this article. [L 1993, c 350, pt of §1]
